_meta.name: English
_meta.notes: The source locale. Every other locale must have exactly these keys. {name} placeholders are filled in by the code; keys ending .one / .other are plural forms.

messages.mfa.error.tooManyCodes: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes before asking for another.
messages.mfa.error.sendFailed: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a moment, or use another method.
messages.mfa.error.codeLocked: Too many incorrect codes. Request a new code.
messages.mfa.error.codeExpired: That code has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
messages.mfa.error.kbaUnavailable: Security questions aren't available for this account right now.

messages.msg.expired.title: This sign-in has expired

messages.msg.appConfig.title: This app can't sign you in

messages.msg.otherAccount.message: This sign-in was started by a different account than the one signed in now. Sign out and start again from the app.

messages.msg.passwordChanged.title: Password changed

messages.setup.secrets.intro: Set these as Worker secrets, then reload this page:

messages.setup.form.intro: Create the first administrator. You need the {token} secret you set when deploying.

messages.setup.form.secondFactor: You will be asked to set up a second factor when you first sign in.
